## objective
V: vitest timeouts 30 s and maxWorkers 4 in vite.config.ts so gates survive a loaded machine
- discovery: Run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` FIRST (the previous attempt skipped it and its gate could not run). Work from goal/T-0001.

Why: machine load average 50 to 80 on 10 cores made the full `npm test` fail on random tests with "Test timed out in 5000ms" or "[vitest-pool-runner]: Timeout waiting for worker to respond"; each file passes alone.

1. vite.config.ts, in the top-level `test` block only (the one with globals and setupFiles), add: `testTimeout: 30000, hookTimeout: 30000, teardownTimeout: 30000, maxWorkers: 4,` (if tsc rejects a key, check node_modules/vitest/dist/*.d.ts for the right name). Do not change projects, includes or anything else. Touch no other file.
2. Run `npm test -- --watch=false`, `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`.
3. Commit as "vitest: longer timeouts and four workers so the gate survives a loaded machine".
## acceptance
- vite.config.ts test block has testTimeout 30000, hookTimeout 30000 and a 4-worker cap; git diff --name-only HEAD~1 lists only vite.config.ts
- Gate green: npm test -- --watch=false, npx tsc --noEmit, npm run lint
